title: Xiaohongshu downloads.json
description: The verification file `collect.py` writes into <noteId>/downloads.json: what was discovered, what was asked for, and where each file landed. It exists so a download can be checked without re-running the collection — none of it is note content, which is why it is not in note.json. A download succeeded only when `state` is "complete" and `filename` is present; a discovered URL proves nothing was fetched.

source.description: The tab this collection ran against.

content.description: Note-body diagnostics. The body itself is in note.json; this records whether the read hit its ceiling.

images.description: The note's own images, after the avatars, icons, emoji and comment pictures were filtered out.

source.description: Where the URL was found: `img`, `srcset`, `source-srcset`, a background image, …

audioVideo.description: Every video/audio source the page exposed, including ones that cannot be downloaded (blob:, HLS, DASH).

downloads.description: One row per requested file, whatever became of it. `state` comes from the browser's own download manager.

filename.description: Where the file is now, after it was moved into the note directory's images/ or videos/.

originalFilename.description: The path in the browser's download directory, kept only when the file was moved.
